notes.title: 1st Anniversary!
notes.content:
"The Patient S Remedy" is celebrating its first anniversary thanks to you.
To commemorate the first anniversary, we are pleased to present a new illustration from Togo, the original illustrator.

Thank you for your continued support!

notes.title: "The Patient S Remedy" update 1.11
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196073/81b0160af4a26a241c3a5e61d86e3d3dc025790f.jpg[/img]

A story of life and death.
Have you touched their lives yet?

In this update 1.11, the English text has been refined.

If you haven't noticed yet, "The Patient S Remedy" is now available in English!
You can also toggle the language setting in the preferences.

We hope you enjoy it!

1.11 Fixes
[list]
    [*]Refinement of English translation
    [*]Minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: "The Patient S Remedy" English + FIGS Update!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41196073/2f8745b9c87b97ec592b07f61b47ebaf8a8acc03.png[/img]

Attention all users! We have a great news for you!

The long-awaited English version of "The Patient S Remedy" is getting a major update!
For customers who have already purchased the Japanese version, we will add-on the English version free of charge!
It will also be compatible with [FIGS] (machine translation).

The update is scheduled for this summer.

notes.title: Regional Restrictions Lifted on “患者Sの救済”
notes.content:
To all Boy’s Love lovers!

We have lifted all regional restrictions for “患者Sの救済”, which was originally released only in Japan due to circumstances, and is now available to be played by a wider range of users!
We also offer a trial version, so if you’re interested, please check it out.

English support is to be determined, but we will appreciate it if you can give us the love and support to make it happen.

We will be waiting for you at Okuseyama Hospital!
